## 3dslibris 3.1.0

Update focused on performance and speed: quicker startup and library browsing, faster book preparation, and smoother reading, search and zoom controls.

### Fixes and improvements

- **Startup:** quicker app initialization before the library appears (measured about 50% less time before the first library draw).
- **Library:** quicker navigation, folder changes and cover loading, with less repeated work when sorting by title or author. Large JPEG covers decode at reduced resolution on 3DS to avoid a full-size RGB memory spike.
- **Opening books:** faster EPUB preparation, lighter MOBI loading and less unnecessary work when reopening cached EPUBs (measured about 30–40% less time preparing EPUB books).
- **Reading:** quicker page turns and redraws, including centered/right-aligned text, code and footnotes (measured **about 80% less time** in the sampled EPUB page turns).
- **PDF/XPS:** GPU-accelerated pan and zoom, reusing loaded page images to keep movement smooth and text sharp. Zooming out can reuse the existing image without rendering the page again. GPU uploads now read decoded pixels directly, avoiding a full intermediate RGB565 bitmap.
- **CBZ:** GPU-accelerated pan and zoom with fewer repeated decodes. Loaded-page zoom changes took about 17 ms instead of 110 ms in two matching examples (about 6.5× faster). Texture preparation also avoids a full intermediate RGB565 bitmap.
- **PDF/CBZ panning:** update the preview more efficiently while dragging and keep the clock and page counter visible.
- **Wide and orientation:** GPU rendering supports Wide top-screen mode where available and all three reading orientations, with automatic software fallback when GPU rendering is unavailable or memory is insufficient.
- **Search:** quicker searches for words and phrases (measured **about 90% less time** searching a full 405-page book with no match).
- **Illustrations:** GPU-accelerated full-screen image viewing in EPUB, MOBI and FB2, with quicker repeated zoom and pan, efficient preview updates and steady controls. The full-screen viewer releases its CPU bitmap once textures and the preview are ready, recovering it if software fallback is needed. Opaque inline images use half the cached pixel memory.
- Restore bookmarks without duplicating them and keep custom font selections when starting the app.

**Page loading:** texture preparation now uses row-based Morton conversion, skips sampling unused padding and avoids the complete RGB565 intermediate on the GPU path. An earlier GPU build averaged 625 ms versus 408 ms before GPU rendering in a matched PDF comparison, with MuPDF rasterization unchanged. Those numbers predate these loading optimizations; updated timings on Old/New 2DS are pending.

Measurements come from Azahar debug comparisons; results vary by book and device. The CBZ zoom figures are based on two matching examples, and XPS has not been measured separately.

### Updating

Reading progress, bookmarks and preferences are kept. No manual cache clearing is needed.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
